data.purpose: Calculated values: final balance, stat values, breakdown numbers. Always tabular-nums.

body.purpose: Sentence-length copy: hero subtitle, modal paragraphs.

label.purpose: Field labels, result labels, table headers.

shadows.name: lifted

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Info modal, the one deliberately heavy shadow in the system.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: Default entrance for hero title and cards, staggered via animation-delay.

motion.purpose: Brief emphasis when a calculated value updates. Modest, not celebratory.

components.name: Primary Nav Pill
components.description: Active nav link inside the rounded nav capsule.
components.html: CalculatorRecommend
components.css: .ds-nav-capsule { background: #faf9f7; border: 1px solid #d5d3cd; border-radius: 200px; padding: 6px; display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-link { text-decoration: none; color: #5d5f68; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 200px; display: inline-block; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-nav-link--active { background: #11151f; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link:hover:not(.ds-nav-link--active) { color: #11151f; background: #e7e6e2; } .ds-nav-link:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: Standard content card with the signature top-edge hairline and earned-depth hover.
components.html:
Your inputs

Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #faf9f7; border: 1px solid #d5d3cd; border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 35, 48, 0.04); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: #2348ad; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: #2348ad; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(28, 35, 48, 0.08); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 20px; color: #11151f; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Numeric input with optional prefix/suffix, used for all calculator fields.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #d5d3cd; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 14px; background: #e7e6e2; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-wrap:hover { border-color: #c9cfd6; } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #2f5abf; background: #faf9f7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47, 90, 191, 0.14); } .ds-input { border: none; background: transparent; outline: none; width: 100%; padding: 11px 6px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #11151f; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input-prefix { color: #5d5f68; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Result Value
components.description: The display-weight numeric output (final balance, stat values) with a brief pop on update.
components.css: .ds-result-value { display: block; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #0b5a55; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-result-value.ds-pop { animation: dsCountPop 0.3s ease-out; } @keyframes dsCountPop { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 40% { transform: scale(1.06); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-result-value.ds-pop { animation: none; } }

components.name: Stat Icon
components.description: 56px gradient-filled rounded square holding a white SVG glyph, one of three gradient variants (blue/teal/amber).
components.css: .ds-stat-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; color: #ffffff; } .ds-stat-icon svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; } .ds-stat-icon--blue { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3a5fd9, #1d3a8f); } .ds-stat-icon--teal { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #129b8f, #0a4842); } .ds-stat-icon--amber { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eba83f, #b06d18); }

narrative.overview: The system reads as math worked out on graph paper, not a banking dashboard. A faint grid sits behind every screen at 5% opacity, reinforcing an analytical, exploratory feel before a single number is shown. A loose constellation of floating dots drifts behind the hero -- closer to a scatter plot warming up than decoration for its own sake. Surfaces are warm off-white paper and card tones, never cold navy-and-gray; text leans toward near-black ink rather than washed-out gray, so the whole thing stays legible and calm rather than corporate or clinical. This system explicitly rejects the stiff corporate banking dashboard (cold navy/gray, dense unexplained tables, jargon with no definitions) and the gamified fintech app (confetti, hype-driven number pop, casino urgency). Where a number does animate (the countPop on result values), it's a brief, modest emphasis -- not a celebration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper/card surfaces, never cold gray-blue
Graph-paper grid + drifting dot field as the system's signature atmosphere
Two real accent colors (teal, blue), each with a clear job
Rounded-pill shapes for chrome; 16px-radius cards for content
Flat at rest, lifts only in response to interaction

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Only teal and blue do real color work on any given screen. Teal means a result/positive outcome. Blue means interactive/decorative. Marigold is reserved, not a third generic accent.

rules.name: The Warm-Never-Cold Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are warm off-white (paper/card), never blue-gray or pure white.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Display Rule
rules.body: Any value derived from the calculator uses tabular-nums and the display font, even at small sizes.

rules.name: The Earned-Depth Rule
rules.body: Nothing ships with a heavy shadow at rest. Depth shows up only as a response to hover, focus, or the modal's deliberate elevation.

dos: Do keep page and input-resting surfaces warm off-white -- never shift toward blue-gray or pure white.
Do use tabular-nums + Space Grotesk for every number derived from user input or calculation, no matter how small.
Do let depth (shadow + lift) be a response to hover/focus only; cards and inputs are flat at rest.
Do keep teal for result/positive outcome and blue for interactive/decorative -- two accents, each with one job.
Do write every English string with a .vi sibling of equal visual weight; never let Vietnamese feel like a translated afterthought.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for the custom cursor, drifting dots, fadeUp entrances, and count-pop.
donts: Don't introduce a cold navy/gray dashboard palette, dense unexplained tables, or unexplained jargon.
Don't add confetti, hype-driven number celebrations, or casino-style urgency cues.
Don't spend marigold decoratively -- it's reserved for a warning/highlight role.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored stripe accent anywhere.
Don't add a static drop shadow to a card or input at rest.
Don't ship plain-language copy with undefined financial jargon -- define terms inline.
